楚.english: surname Chu; abbr. for Hubei 湖北省[Hu2bei3 Sheng3] and Hunan 湖南省[Hu2nan2 Sheng3] provinces together; Chinese kingdom during the Spring and Autumn and Warring States Periods (722-221 BC); distinct; clear; orderly; pain; suffering; deciduous bush used in Chinese medicine (genus Vitex); punishment cane (old)

告.english: (bound form) to say; to tell; to announce; to report; to denounce; to file a lawsuit; to sue

公.english: public; collectively owned; common; international (e.g. high seas, metric system, calendar); make public; fair; just; Duke, highest of five orders of nobility 五等爵位[wu3 deng3 jue2 wei4]; honorable (gentlemen); father-in-law; male (animal)

年代.english: a decade of a century (e.g. the Sixties); age; era; period; CL:個|个[ge4]

下來.english: to come down; (completed action marker); (after verb of motion, indicates motion down and towards us, also fig.); (indicates continuation from the past towards us); to be harvested (of crops); to be over (of a period of time); to go among the masses (said of leaders)

人才.english: talent; talented person; looks; attractive looks

時候.english: time; length of time; moment; period

直接.english: direct (opposite: indirect 間接|间接[jian4 jie1]); immediate; straightforward

說出.english: to speak out; to declare (one's view)

一個.english: a; an; one; the whole (afternoon, summer vacation etc)

一句.english: a line of verse; a sentence

意思.english: idea; opinion; meaning; wish; desire; interest; fun; token of appreciation, affection etc; CL:個|个[ge4]; to give as a small token; to do sth as a gesture of goodwill etc

因為.english: because; owing to; on account of

起來.english: to stand up; to get up; also pr. [qi3lai2]; (after a verb) indicating the beginning and continuation of an action or a state; indicating an upward movement (e.g. after 站[zhan4]); indicating completion; (after a perception verb, e.g. 看[kan4]) expressing preliminary judgment; also pr. [qi3lai5]

可以.english: can; may; possible; able to; not bad; pretty good

九月.english: September; ninth month (of the lunar year)

多年.english: many years; for many years; longstanding

相信.english: to believe; to be convinced; to accept as true

真的.english: really; truly; indeed; real; true; genuine; (math.) proper

一一.english: one by one; one after another

清楚.english: clear; distinct; to understand thoroughly; to be clear about

這不.english: (coll.) As a matter of fact, ... (used to introduce evidence for what one has just asserted)

可能.english: might (happen); possible; probable; possibility; probability; maybe; perhaps; CL:個|个[ge4]

一起.english: (in) the same place; together; in company (with); altogether; in total; an instance of; a case of (murder, accident, dispute etc)

一直.english: straight (in a straight line); continuously; always; all the way through

十月.english: October; tenth month (of the lunar year)

改變.english: to change; to alter; to transform

根本.english: fundamental; basic; root; simply; absolutely (not); (not) at all; CL:個|个[ge4]

年來.english: this past year; over the last years

打掉.english: to tear down; to destroy; to dismantle (a gang); to abort (a fetus)

沒有.english: haven't; hasn't; doesn't exist; to not have; to not be

只有.english: only have ...; there is only ...; (used in combination with 才[cai2]) it is only if one ... (that one can ...) (Example: 只有通過治療才能痊愈|只有通过治疗才能痊愈[zhi3 you3 tong1 guo4 zhi4 liao2 cai2 neng2 quan2 yu4] "the only way to cure it is with therapy"); it is only ... (who ...) (Example: 只有男性才有此需要[zhi3 you3 nan2 xing4 cai2 you3 ci3 xu1 yao4] "only men would have such a requirement"); (used to indicate that one has no alternative) one can only (do a certain thing) (Example: 只有屈服[zhi3 you3 qu1 fu2] "the only thing you can do is give in")
